commit f05a066b0b556d727dca5d9a8737f1c594710923
Author:     welpy-cw <h.w.forms@arcor.de>

CommitDate: Tue Feb 24 10:26:50 2026 +0000

    Bug 2018545 - Align AppxManifest protocol and file associations with nsWindowsShellService.cpp logic. r=mkmelin
    
    
    The `AppxManifest.xml.in` for the MSIX/Windows Store build uses incorrect command-line
    parameters for several protocols and file associations. Because these parameters
    do not align with the security-restricted parsing logic in `nsWindowsShellService.cpp`,
    external requests (like clicking a `news://` link or opening an `.eml` file)
    are rejected by the browser's command-line handler.
    
    This ensures parity between the Windows Store package and the standard
    Win32 installer registry configuration.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D284426

diff --git a/mail/installer/windows/msix/AppxManifest.xml.in b/mail/installer/windows/msix/AppxManifest.xml.in
index bfc7713ab1f..904e3c9ad09 100644
--- a/mail/installer/windows/msix/AppxManifest.xml.in
+++ b/mail/installer/windows/msix/AppxManifest.xml.in
@@ -69,7 +69,7 @@
             </uap:SupportedFileTypes>
             <uap:Logo>Assets\Email44x44.png</uap:Logo>
             <uap2:SupportedVerbs>
-              <uap3:Verb Id="open" Parameters="-osint -mail "%1"">open</uap3:Verb>
+              <uap3:Verb Id="open" Parameters=""%1"">open</uap3:Verb>
             </uap2:SupportedVerbs>
           </uap3:FileTypeAssociation>
         </uap3:Extension>
@@ -82,7 +82,7 @@
             </uap:SupportedFileTypes>
             <uap:Logo>Assets\Calendar44x44.png</uap:Logo>
             <uap2:SupportedVerbs>
-              <uap3:Verb Id="open" Parameters="-osint "%1"">open</uap3:Verb>
+              <uap3:Verb Id="open" Parameters=""%1"">open</uap3:Verb>
             </uap2:SupportedVerbs>
           </uap3:FileTypeAssociation>
         </uap3:Extension>
@@ -93,37 +93,37 @@
           </uap3:Protocol>
         </uap3:Extension>
         <uap3:Extension Category="windows.protocol">
-          <uap3:Protocol Name="mid" Parameters="-osint -url "%1"">
+          <uap3:Protocol Name="mid" Parameters=""%1"">
             <uap:DisplayName>mid</uap:DisplayName>
             <uap:Logo>Assets\Email44x44.png</uap:Logo>
           </uap3:Protocol>
         </uap3:Extension>
         <uap3:Extension Category="windows.protocol">
-          <uap3:Protocol Name="nntp" Parameters="-osint -url "%1"">
+          <uap3:Protocol Name="nntp" Parameters="-osint -mail "%1"">
             <uap:DisplayName>nntp</uap:DisplayName>
             <uap:Logo>Assets\News44x44.png</uap:Logo>
           </uap3:Protocol>
         </uap3:Extension>
         <uap3:Extension Category="windows.protocol">
-          <uap3:Protocol Name="news" Parameters="-osint -url "%1"">
+          <uap3:Protocol Name="news" Parameters="-osint -mail "%1"">
             <uap:DisplayName>news</uap:DisplayName>
             <uap:Logo>Assets\News44x44.png</uap:Logo>
           </uap3:Protocol>
         </uap3:Extension>
         <uap3:Extension Category="windows.protocol">
-          <uap3:Protocol Name="snews" Parameters="-osint -url "%1"">
+          <uap3:Protocol Name="snews" Parameters="-osint -mail "%1"">
             <uap:DisplayName>snews</uap:DisplayName>
             <uap:Logo>Assets\News44x44.png</uap:Logo>
           </uap3:Protocol>
         </uap3:Extension>
         <uap3:Extension Category="windows.protocol">
-          <uap3:Protocol Name="webcal" Parameters="-osint -url "%1"">
+          <uap3:Protocol Name="webcal" Parameters=""%1"">
             <uap:DisplayName>webcal</uap:DisplayName>
             <uap:Logo>Assets\Calendar44x44.png</uap:Logo>
           </uap3:Protocol>
         </uap3:Extension>
         <uap3:Extension Category="windows.protocol">
-          <uap3:Protocol Name="webcals" Parameters="-osint -url "%1"">
+          <uap3:Protocol Name="webcals" Parameters=""%1"">
             <uap:DisplayName>webcals</uap:DisplayName>

           </uap3:Protocol>
